corrections.old_text: ዲል ፤ አፎ ኮነ ወልደ እጓለ እ↵
corrections.corrected_text: ዲል ፤ እፎ ኮነ ወልደ እጓለ እ↵
corrections.reason: Ge'ez interrogative adverb እፎ ('how', 6th order እ) in 'እፎ ኮነ ወልደ እጓለ እመሕያው', misread as 1st order አፎ.
Ethiopic word የዘቢብ ('of raisins/grapes') had its last two characters corrupted into Arabic script.
Amharic verb ይሰጥበታል (6th order ጥ followed by 1st order በ) was transposed in vowel orders as ይሰጠብታል.
